subject: chemistry
content: What weight of the non-volatile solute, urea(NH<sub>2</sub> - CO - NH<sub>2</sub>) needs to be dissolved in 100g of water, in order to decrease the vapour pressure of water by 25%? What will be the molality of the solution?
